name: AutomationDirect CL-2230 wire-retaining accessory
summary: CL-2230 wire-retaining accessory arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: CL-2230 is the drawing identifier for wire-retaining accessory in AutomationDirect's Wire Duct collection. A wire retainer helps hold conductors in the selected wiring-management arrangement. It is separate from the channel body and from the structural support of an external cable route.

For example, in a control-panel duct route that needs conductors retained during servicing, use the CL-2230 reference to coordinate duct interface, conductor space and cover access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Wire Duct/Accessories/CL-2230.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep duct interface, conductor space and cover access visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named CL-2230 drawing and its wire-retaining accessory role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match CL-2230, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
